title: Supply of Tubular batteries for Dhanushkodi Lighthouse
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supplying four Exide 12V/200Ah C10 tall tubular lead-acid solar batteries to Dhanushkodi Lighthouse, Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Dhanushkodi Lighthouse, Dhanushkodi Post, Rameswaram Taluk, Ramanathapuram Dist.

scope.item: Supply of Exide make 12V/200Ah C10 tall tubular lead acid battery, 60 months warranty, suitable for solar applications
Packing and transportation charges to Dhanushkodi Lighthouse

money.notes: GST paid as per actual. 100% payment after receipt of items in good condition. Paying authority: The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Chennai.

period.completion: Supply within 30 days from acceptance of purchase order
period.warranty: 60 months (5 years from date of supply)

eligibility: Reputed firms or authorised dealers or agents; quotation with credentials and descriptive brochures
specs: Exide 12V/200Ah C10 tall tubular lead acid battery for solar applications, 60 months warranty
notes: Quotations due 19/09/2022 15:00, opened 16:00. No estimated cost or EMD. Brand specified (Exide). Listing directorate 'DGLL' though issued by Chennai Directorate.
